title: LocalManifest
description: Client Agent report (C# agent EXE). machine_state is embedded VERBATIM from the agent's State Module Record (ported MachineState.ps1 semantics; no PowerShell deployed); do not remap or restate its fields anywhere else in this document.

display_name.description: server-assigned; client echoes it, never invents it

machine_state.description: Opaque passthrough of the agent State Module's Record JSON (computerName, machineManufacturer, machineModel, displays, startup items, StartupApproved state, screensaver, wallpaper, software inventory incl. full Uninstall-key entries across HKLM/HKCU x 64/32 registry views (WOW6432Node and per-user installs included; each entry carries hive + view), windowsUpdate summary {status, pending_count, last_scan_unix, error} from the agent's Windows Update poll, extended during/after an operator-requested install run (T33) with {install_state: running|done|failed, install_done, install_total, install_error, reboot_pending}, wallpaperSync verdict {drift, expected_sha256, actual_sha256} from the agent's per-beat wallpaper drift check, steamCmd verdict {found, path, source, install_state, error} from the agent's SteamCMD locate + winget bootstrap; null/absent when never polled / nothing enforced; apps array — one row per venue-catalog entry (chrome, firefox, steam, epic, battlenet, riot) as {app_id, installed, version, up_to_date, checked_unix}, up_to_date null when the vendor exposes no current-version API (self-updating launchers), selfUpdate verdict {current, latest, state: up_to_date|update_available|downloading|ready|restarting|restart_pending|failed|error, progress, error, checked_unix} from the agent's GitHub release check + staged-EXE self-handoff. Single owner: the agent's State Module.

game_reports.description: Net-new section: folder-scan discovery, the only capture logic outside the engine.

duplicates.description: Same game_id found under multiple folders; resolution is the server's decision, never the client's.
